title: [TEST SYNTHETIC] Whole cube single stress tensor — copper analytical reference
creator: Xue, Jun
description: Single whole cube stress tensor with tensile xx = 15 MPa and yy = 5 MPa, compressive zz = -5 MPa, and symmetric xy = yx = 2 MPa shear for Pull, Push and Shear display testing. This example derives from recorded step 1 of the original twelve-state copper reference, adding compression in zz and recalculating the corresponding stress and isotropic small elastic strain sample. All nine tensor components remain explicit, and plastic strain remains zero; no finite element model was solved. Material parameters and orientations are illustrative assumptions.
rights: Generated synthetic fixture for local platform testing
processor_specifications: x86_64; Python analytical calculation, no finite element solver
